Documentation.TagDescription: WMS reference data backed by a local SQLite database. No external dependencies required.

MethodDescriptions.PATCH: Update part of a storage bin
MethodDescriptions.MERGE: Update part of a storage bin

MethodDocumentation.GET: Browse the storage bins of a warehouse, each one belonging to a zone and carrying a capacity in units. Supports `$filter`, `$select`, `$orderby`, `$top`, `$skip`.
MethodDocumentation.POST: Add a bin. `Code`, `Zone` and `CapacityUnits` are required, and the generated `Id` comes back in the response.
MethodDocumentation.PUT: Replace a bin in full. Send every column you want to keep, including the `Id` that identifies the row.
MethodDocumentation.PATCH: Send only the columns that change, along with the `Id`. Columns you leave out keep their current values.
MethodDocumentation.MERGE: Identical to `PATCH`, under the name OData clients use. Both reach the same write path.
MethodDocumentation.DELETE: Remove a bin by its `Id`. Deleting a bin that does not exist returns `404`.
